name: hard_task_failure_replay
question: On tasks the GPT family rarely solves, can gpt-5.6-sol / medium solve them when it sees that same task's failed official attempts, a failure analysis another model wrote from them, or both, and which builder writes the most useful analysis?
benchmark: Terminal-Bench 2.1 revision 6 (package 2.0.2), task packages from the main TB2.1 data

selection.ranking: GPT-5.6-family (Luna, Terra) official pass rate ascending, then overall official pass rate ascending
selection.hard_label: overall official pass rate <= 0.35, or GPT-5.6-family pass rate == 0

builder.budget: V6 adaptive rule: clamp(300 + 30 * failed_attempts + 60 * ceil(MiB), 600, 3600) seconds

arms.control: Main-experiment vanilla baseline adapter, unchanged: official instruction and deadline only.
arms.failure_replay: Same adapter plus a read-only /experience mount with this task's failed official attempts and the Luna summary; the summary is also pasted into the prompt.
arms.traj_only: Same adapter plus a read-only /experience/failed_attempts mount with this task's failed official attempts; no summary.
arms.mem_<builder>: Same adapter plus the v3 failure analysis by that builder, pasted into the prompt and mounted at /experience/memory; no transcripts.
arms.mem_opus55v4: Same as mem_<builder>, with the analysis written by Opus 5.5 under prompt v4 (no environment-tampering advice).
arms.trajmem_<builder>: Same adapter plus both read-only mounts: /experience/failed_attempts (this task's failed official attempts, as traj_only) and /experience/memory (that builder's frozen analysis, as mem_<builder>); the analysis is also pasted into the prompt. Added 2026-10-07 because the requested design was trajectories + memory, while mem_<builder> gave the analysis only.

rollouts_per_arm: 2 per arm in r2/r3 (control, failure_replay); 3 per arm in v3r1-v3r3 (traj_only, mem_*), control gets a third rollout in v3r1
preflight: The official reference solution (Harbor oracle agent) must score 1 on each chosen task before any model run.
builders_note: gpt-6-luna and gpt-6.1-sol were requested first but are not available through Codex with this ChatGPT account (server: 'not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account'); the user chose gpt-5.6-terra and gpt-5.6-sol instead (2026-10-07). Round 3 (user request, 2026-10-07): added gpt-6-astra and claude-opus-5-5 as stronger builders, same v3 prompt, medium effort. Round 4 (user request, 2026-10-07): opus55v4 = the same Opus 5.5 builder with prompt v4, which adds one rule forbidding recommendations that pass a check by changing the environment it runs in (e.g. Python startup hooks); added after the mem_opus55 pypi-server solves installed .pth/sitecustomize hooks.
distill_prompt: prompts/distill_prompt_v3.txt (v2 discarded: it described the grading; see runs/invalid/distill_v2_grading_note)
